title.narrative: Comprehensive Support to Resume Education Services in Axum Town, Central Zone of Tigray Region

description.narrative: ltpgtltspangtBased on the information obtained from the Rehabilitation department of Social Affairs Office of Axum town above 80% above of the people have had experienced very high levels of financial and livelihood losses and/or deterioration of basic services in last six months as a result of the recent crisis. With regard to education service, our primary data collected on September 16, 2023 from same government office confirms that almost all school-aged children in the community have stopped attending school or reduced their attendance because of the negative situation in last 6 months. The most prevailing factors that hinder the school learning process are schoolslt/spangtltspangt’ infrastructure and teaching equipment are destroyed and schools are being used to host displaced people. This project proposal is designed to accelerate the resumption of a hugely disrupted education service in three selected schools in Axum town, Central Zone of Tigray region. Since the last few years, 7,691 students of these three schools have ceased attendance due to this massive disruption which could carry profound and lasting implications for the region's human capital development. At the moment, these three schools are serving as temporary shelter for 28,196 internally displace people. Apart from the consequence of the conflict, being the shelter of over-populated IDPs damages most of the schools’ infrastructures and hence it can no longer give the same service as before unless and otherwise important rehabilitation is done. Besides, the data from the need assessment indicates that humanitarian aid has never been provided in the community at all and this finding highlights the urgent need for intervention to address the community's priority needs. In terms of priority needs, respondents ranked "food security," "shelter," and "health" as top choices, aligning with the immediate requirements of a post-conflict community seeking to rebuild their lives and regain stability. Overall, the assessment finding underscores the complex challenges faced by students and IDPs in Axum town in the post-conflict and the necessity of a comprehensive and integrated humanitarian responses to support recovery and resilience-building efforts. Thus, this project proposal selected four main clusters which are CCCM, Education, Wash, ESNFI, and Protection among OCHA’s priority clusters and prioritized locations are schools allocated for IDPs and schools shared by IDPs. With this understanding, the project aims to re-locate those IDPs dwelling in the three schools and rehabilitate the schools’ infrastructure so as to ensure that students can continue their education.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtlt/spangtlt/pgt
